security_probation_001.evidence: All teachers in the public schools in cities of the first class during the first three years of consecutive employment shall be deemed to be in a probationary period of employment... After the completion of such probationary period, without discharge, such teachers as are thereupon reemployed shall continue in service and hold their respective position during good behavior and efficient and competent service

security_nonrenewal_002.evidence: A probationary teacher is deemed to have been reemployed for the ensuing school year, unless the school board in charge of such school gave such teacher notice in writing before July 1 of the termination of such employment... must not be discharged or demoted except for cause after a hearing

security_seniority_definition_003.evidence: The interview pool shall consist of eight (8) candidates for each position which shall include the top four (4) senior applicants, two (2) applicants currently teaching in the District, and two (2) applicants to be selected by the site interview team

security_voluntary_transfer_004.answer: The streamlined Interview & Select process requires positions to be posted online for five duty days. Candidates apply online, upload resumes, and sign up for interviews. The interview pool consists of eight candidates: top four senior applicants, two current district teachers, and two selected by the site interview team. One round of interviews occurs centrally. Teachers have 48 hours to accept or decline via the posting system.
security_voluntary_transfer_004.evidence: The catalogue of open positions will be open for five (5) duty days. Candidates shall go online to upload their resume and sign up for interviews for positions... The interview pool shall consist of eight (8) candidates for each position which shall include the top four (4) senior applicants, two (2) applicants currently teaching in the District, and two (2) applicants to be selected by the site interview team... Teachers will have forty-eight (48) hours to accept or decline the job offer
